destination: East US 2 A100 80GB PCIe, 300W power limit
limitations: Two EngineCore streams lack process_final; zero dropped telemetry is not established.
The final 30K/concurrency16 repeat has 245 missing worker token records despite complete client output; exclude it from server timing fits.
Four coding service boundary outcomes remain: two timeout failures and two censored. Requests without first SSE have unresolved ID joins.
Duplicate SIGTERM during EngineCore shutdown is a code-supported and CPU-reproduced explanation for buffered tail loss; this run lacks signal traces proving it.
Future acquisition must signal the serving API leader once, flush engine telemetry before teardown, and require per-core final records. No retry or post-hoc reconstruction was performed.
East is a new environment, not direct reproduction of Germany timing. Relative CUDA stream elapsed is not exclusive GPU busy time; different-host monotonic clocks are never subtracted.
No coefficients were fitted and no fleet policy simulation was run.
